title: Manipulation of Arbitrary-Order Cavity-Magnon Polariton Blockade
summary: Manipulating the cavity-magnon polariton blockade is significant for achieving precise, on-demand control of individual photons (magnons) and has particular applications in realizing multifunctional quantum technologies, quantum information processing, and hybrid quantum networks. In this paper, we theoretically propose a scheme to realize an $n$-cavity-magnon polariton blockade in a cavity-magnon system by utilizing Kerr nonlinearity.
